Definition: a viper (as thrusting out the tongue, i.e. hissing)
BiblicalUsage: tsephaʻ stands behind the English phrase a viper, a poisonous serpent. In Proverbs 23:32, At the last it biteth like a serpent, and it appears again in Isaiah 11:8.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the viper in Proverbs is a warning I can feel, and the child playing by its hole in Isaiah is the peace I long for.
